narr: Scattered thunderstorms along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of the Lower Maryland Eastern Shore.
ev: Flash flooding or high water was reported on several roads in West Ocean City.
High water was reported over South 2nd Street with one vehicle stuck in the water.
Flooded road was reported near Ocean City Inlet.
Street flooding was reported with a street closed. Vehicles were stranded.
